status: MODELED: volumes exact where meshes exist (lower bounds where parts are boxes); compound properties ASSUMED class ranges (no product chosen)

GEL.name: soft silicone gel (low stress, dielectric gel class)

CC.name: conformal coat (silicone or acrylic class), 25-75 um

zones.zone: NPM hot zone (PB1R FETs, clamp diode, shunt)
zones.why: heat to the module wall; HV nodes wetted void-free
light, locks the board and the leads

zones.zone: L2 analog cell (AB1A / AB1B, FFC links)
zones.why: locks boards and links against vibration (microphonics), no hard-resin stress on the precision parts

zones.zone: L1 gallery (RX leads, spine flex start)
zones.why: RX leads that move are microphonic noise
zones.source: exact mesh boolean (core and base plate)

zones.why: locks PM2 and the power leads; AU1 stays reachable above (coated)
zones.source: exact mesh boolean, PM2 as a box (lower bound)

zones.why: locks HB2 and the cord joint; the Hall switch reads through the wall
zones.source: exact mesh boolean, HB2 as a box (lower bound)

windings.rule: only a fill that keeps the quiet time >= 0.10 us before the first gate in the whole phi range
windings.decision: no pour on the windings: lock the turns with a thin SYN bead at the ends only and verify on the bench

bench_tests.what: compound properties of the chosen products
bench_tests.data: density, thermal conductivity, relative permittivity at 100 kHz-1 MHz, dielectric strength, Shore hardness, cure shrinkage, CTE, outgassing
bench_tests.how: manufacturer datasheets (log in DATASHEET_LOG); replace the ASSUMED class ranges in this script
bench_tests.pass_: every zone keeps its function with the real numbers (re-run potting_map.py)

bench_tests.what: coil self-capacitance and quiet time, bare vs end-bead lock
bench_tests.data: C_self of one wound former (impedance analyser, SRF), t_quiet on the bench (scope on the drain and the RX input)
bench_tests.how: before and after the SYN end beads; then one former test-potted in SYN as a sacrificial sample
bench_tests.pass_: t_quiet <= first gate - 0.10 us (fw_timeline.json) with the beads; record the potted sample's delay

bench_tests.what: RX microphonics, L1 / L2 unpotted vs GEL
bench_tests.data: RX output noise during a tap / swing test (fixed tap energy), 10 trials each
bench_tests.how: AB1 outputs on the logger, head swung on the rig
bench_tests.pass_: GEL reduces the tap response; no change of the quiet (no-tap) noise floor

bench_tests.data: weight of each poured zone, head and handle mass, balance point on the armrest
bench_tests.pass_: within the ranges in this file; balance point recorded

bench_tests.what: thermal, NPM hot zone and vault
bench_tests.data: FET case and hot-zone temperature at boost, 25 / 40 C ambient, 30 min
bench_tests.pass_: below the model limits (vault 80 C, PETG); the potted case not hotter than the unpotted model

bench_tests.what: high voltage in the NPM fill
bench_tests.data: hipot DRAIN1 / CLAMP1 to everything at 1 kV (harness test T05/T06), partial discharge if available
X-ray or a cut sacrificial sample per compound; adhesion to PETG / FR4 / silicone wire
bench_tests.how: sample pours with the production degassing
bench_tests.pass_: no void at an HV node or a lead exit; no delamination after 10 thermal cycles

bench_tests.data: every net continuity (netlist), plane HV keep-outs untouched, ring-down / leak bench items

coat_only.why: RX lobes: a pour adds capacitance to the receive coils (sbq_damp model); coat only
Pico 2 W antenna and 10.2 mm parts under LB1; coat + wire staking
LEDs shine through the pixel holes: clear coat only
speaker, jack, selector leads and the SWD pads stay free; coat + staking

keep_out.why: cords move with the trigger and the housings

keep_out.item: battery pack U7 and dock U6
keep_out.why: removable pack; Li-ion cells need a vent path

keep_out.item: moving parts: trigger, dial, power button, latch

U3_PM2_bay.note: PM2 parts as one bounding box: the fill volume is a lower bound; AU1 above stays free (coated)

U1_HB2_pocket.note: pocket = HB2 envelope + 1 mm, from 3 mm under the board

checks.vault_note: the thermal model is unpotted air; replacing air (0.026 W/mK) by GEL (0.15-0.2) only adds conduction, so the unpotted worst case is an upper bound
